description: Read your virtual credit balance (visitor token required). Top-ups and subscriptions are being prepared; this tool only reads the current balance. Use when you need your own credit balance before a paid call. Example arguments: {"action": "balance", "visitor_token": "vt_..."} Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.

account_id.description: Your own visitor account ID (defaults to the authenticated visitor ID)

action.description: Action: balance to check your credits.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: credit

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.

title: Read workspace credits
